acceptedList: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC (scripts/lib/license_policy.py ACCEPTED)
basis: Reviewed on 2026-11-13 from each wheel's own METADATA and licence files as retained under the runtime's Licences/ directory, and for two rows from the wheel's member list. Every evidence entry is pinned to the digest in the runtime manifest. Where a wheel omits the licence text of something it bundles or compiles in, the row's `retained` entry names the text kept in the repository, the source release it was copied from and its digest; where the source release has none either, `withoutLicenceText` names the part, the outside evidence retained for it (URL, retrieval date, digest) and whether that evidence was accepted. Native code compiled into a wheel's extension modules is described for matplotlib; for the other wheels it is described only as far as their own licence files describe it. The Pyodide runtime itself, CPython and Emscripten are not rows here: their licence files are pinned by scripts/package-pyodide.py.

verdicts.accepted: the licence is on the accepted list, or the checker names it for this package (scripts/lib/license_policy.py PYODIDE_EXCEPTIONS, D126); the row's `exceptions` repeat that set for the reader
verdicts.not-accepted: the wheel's own files settle the licence, and it is not on the accepted list; fails the scan until decided
verdicts.review: the wheel's own files do not settle the licence of everything it ships; fails the scan until decided
verdicts.accepted-without-evidence: for a part under `withoutLicenceText` only: no permission text was found and the owner accepted the part knowing that (D126); the checker holds the exact files by path and SHA-256 (scripts/lib/license_policy.py PYODIDE_ACCEPTED_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE)

withoutLicenceText.finding: The module contains FreeType. Pyodide's recipe for matplotlib 3.10.8 (pyodide-recipes, packages/matplotlib/meta.yaml, main branch as retrieved on 2026-11-13) builds against Emscripten's FreeType port; Pyodide at the packaged revision pins Emscripten 5.0.3 (Makefile.envs), whose port is FreeType VER-2-13-3 (tools/ports/freetype.py). Neither the wheel nor the source release carries FreeType's licence. The FTL asks for a credit in the documentation of a binary distribution: a release requirement.

evidence.shows: The FreeType Project LICENSE (FTL) at the VER-2-13-3 tag. It asks a binary distribution to state in its documentation that it uses FreeType
FreeType is offered under two licences, of which the user chooses one: the FTL or GPL version 2. The FTL is the one named here

withoutLicenceText.finding: Each carries "Copyright (c) 1989, 1991 Adobe Systems Incorporated. All Rights Reserved." and no permission text. Adobe granted permission for the Utopia typefaces twice; both grants are for the typefaces, and the first names their Adobe Font Metric files. The shipped files are Adobe's revision 001.002 of January 1992; the files that X.Org and the TeX Users Group distribute under these grants are revision 001.001 of October 1991, with different metrics for some glyphs. Both grants require the Adobe copyright notice and trademark attribution in copies.

evidence.shows: Adobe's grant with its donation to the X Consortium: permission to use, reproduce, display and distribute the Utopia typefaces, named as "Type 1 font program, bitmaps and Adobe Font Metric files" for Utopia Regular, Italic, Bold and Bold Italic, provided the Adobe copyright notice and trademark attribution appear

Adobe's licence of 11 October 2006 to the TeX Users Group for "the typeface software for the Utopia Regular, Utopia Italic, Utopia Bold and Utopia bold Italic typefaces", sublicensed by TUG to all interested parties on 17 November 2006

withoutLicenceText.finding: Each carries an Adobe Systems copyright notice with "All Rights Reserved" and no permission text. Adobe's notice for its Core 35 AFM files names the same 35 fonts, but it grants permission for "the 35 PostScript(R) AFM files it accompanies": the later editions in its two Core 35 archives, whose copyright lines end 1997 or 1999. The shipped files are earlier editions of the same fonts, created between 1989 and 1992: 31 are version 001.004 to 001.009, and the four Courier files (pcrb8a, pcrbo8a, pcrr8a, pcrro8a) are version 002.004 of September 1991; all are StartFontMetrics 2.0. None equals a file in either Adobe archive. No notice for the shipped editions was found. Accepted without permission evidence by the owner's decision (D126).
